database.description: MySQL database name to connect to. Defaults to 'mysql'. May also be provided via MYSQL_DATABASE environment variable.

endpoint.description: MySQL server endpoint (host:port). May also be provided via MYSQL_ENDPOINT environment variable.

innodb_lock_wait_timeout.description: MySQL session innodb_lock_wait_timeout in seconds. Defaults to 1. May also be provided via MYSQL_INNODB_LOCK_WAIT_TIMEOUT environment variable.

lock_wait_timeout.description: MySQL session lock_wait_timeout in seconds (metadata lock timeout). Defaults to 60. May also be provided via MYSQL_LOCK_WAIT_TIMEOUT environment variable.

password.description: MySQL password. May also be provided via MYSQL_PASSWORD environment variable.

tls.description: TLS configuration for the MySQL connection. Options: 'true', 'false', 'skip-verify', 'preferred'. Defaults to 'preferred'. May also be provided via MYSQL_TLS environment variable.

tls_ca_file.description: Path to a PEM-encoded CA certificate file for MySQL TLS. May also be provided via MYSQL_TLS_CA environment variable.

tls_cert_file.description: Path to a PEM-encoded client certificate file for MySQL TLS. May also be provided via MYSQL_TLS_CERT environment variable.

tls_key_file.description: Path to a PEM-encoded client key file for MySQL TLS. May also be provided via MYSQL_TLS_KEY environment variable.

tls_server_name.description: Server name for TLS verification (SNI). May also be provided via MYSQL_TLS_SERVER_NAME environment variable.

tls_skip_verify.description: Skip TLS certificate verification. May also be provided via MYSQL_TLS_SKIP_VERIFY environment variable.

username.description: MySQL username. May also be provided via MYSQL_USERNAME environment variable.

wait_timeout.description: MySQL session wait_timeout in seconds (idle connection timeout). Defaults to 10000. May also be provided via MYSQL_WAIT_TIMEOUT environment variable.

block.description: The Audit Log Filter provider manages Percona Server 8.4+ audit log filters and user assignments. It provides resources to create, modify, and remove audit log filters using the audit_log_filter component functions.

definition.description: JSON definition of the audit log filter. This must be a valid JSON object that defines the filter rules according to MySQL audit log filter syntax. **WARNING**: Changing this value will cause the filter to be recreated, temporarily affecting active sessions using this filter.

filter_id.description: Internal filter ID assigned by MySQL.

id.description: Unique identifier for the audit log filter (same as name).

name.description: Name of the audit log filter. Must be unique across all filters.

block.description:
Manages a Percona Server audit log filter using the audit_log_filter component.

This resource allows you to create, update, and delete audit log filters that define which events should be logged. The filter definition must be a valid JSON object that conforms to the MySQL audit log filter syntax.

filter_name.description: Name of the audit log filter to assign to the user. The filter must exist.

id.description: Unique identifier for the user assignment (username@userhost).

userhost.description: Host pattern for the user assignment. Use '%' to match any host. This is combined with username to form the complete user specification.

username.description: MySQL username to assign the filter to. Use '%' for default assignment.

block.description:
Manages user assignments to audit log filters using the audit_log_filter component.

This resource allows you to assign users to specific audit log filters, enabling targeted auditing for different users. The user can be specified with a username and host pattern, or use '%' for the default filter assignment.
